description: Build a circuit where flipping a lever turns on a lamp
verification_behavior: Lamp is off initially, turns on when lever is flipped, turns back off when lever is restored

description: Create a circuit where a lamp is powered directly by a redstone block placed next to it
verification_behavior: Lamp is lit as long as the redstone block is adjacent to it

description: Make a redstone torch inverter so a lamp turns off when a lever is flipped on, and turns on when the lever is off
verification_behavior: Lamp is on when lever is off; lamp turns off when lever is flipped on

description: Build an AND gate that lights a lamp only when both of two levers are flipped on
verification_behavior: Lamp off when either or both levers are off; lamp on only when both levers are on

description: Create an OR gate where a lamp turns on if either of two levers is flipped on
verification_behavior: Lamp off only when both levers are off; lamp on when either or both levers are on

description: Build a circuit where pressing a button turns on two lamps at the same time
verification_behavior: Both lamps light up simultaneously when button is pressed; both turn off when button timer expires

description: Create a circuit where stepping on a pressure plate opens an iron door
verification_behavior: Iron door opens when pressure plate is activated; door closes when pressure plate is released

description: Build a circuit where flipping a lever causes a piston to extend and push a block forward
verification_behavior: Piston is retracted when lever is off; piston extends and pushes block when lever is flipped on

description: Create a circuit with a long line of redstone dust that uses a repeater to carry the signal all the way to a lamp
verification_behavior: Lamp at the end of the dust line is lit because the repeater restores signal strength

description: Build a circuit where placing or breaking a block in front of an observer flashes a lamp briefly
verification_behavior: Lamp flashes on briefly when a block is placed or broken in front of the observer's face

description: Build a NOR gate where a lamp is on only when both of two levers are off
verification_behavior: Lamp on when both levers are off; lamp turns off when either lever is flipped on

description: Create a NAND gate where a lamp stays on unless both of two levers are flipped on at the same time
verification_behavior: Lamp on when either or both levers are off; lamp turns off only when both levers are on

description: Build a circuit where flipping a lever opens a trapdoor, creating a hole in the floor
verification_behavior: Trapdoor is closed when lever is off; trapdoor flips open when lever is on

description: Create a circuit where pressing a button makes a noteblock play a sound
verification_behavior: Noteblock is silent initially; noteblock produces a sound when button is pressed

description: Build a circuit where a comparator reads the fullness of a chest and lights a lamp when the chest has any items
verification_behavior: Lamp is off when chest is empty; lamp turns on when items are placed in the chest

description: Create a T-flip-flop that toggles a lamp on and off each time you press a button, making the button act like a lever
verification_behavior: Lamp toggles state on each button press: off→on→off→on; pressing repeatedly cycles the lamp state

description: Build a 2x2 piston door that opens when you flip a lever, hiding the entrance in a wall
verification_behavior: 4 door blocks form a seamless wall when closed; lever flip retracts blocks to reveal a 2x2 opening

description: Build a redstone clock using repeaters in a loop so a lamp blinks on and off repeatedly
verification_behavior: Lamp alternates between on and off at a steady rhythm; clocking pattern continues indefinitely

description: Make a monostable circuit (pulse limiter) that turns a long lever flip into a short pulse, so a lamp blinks briefly regardless of how long the lever is held
verification_behavior: Lamp blinks on briefly and turns off even while lever stays on; lamp does not stay lit

description: Build an RS NOR latch that remembers which of two buttons was pressed last, lighting a lamp for set and keeping it off for reset
verification_behavior: Lamp turns on when set button is pressed and stays on; lamp turns off when reset button is pressed and stays off

description: Create a hopper chain that moves items from an input chest down through a hopper into a chest below
verification_behavior: Items placed in the top chest appear in the bottom chest after a short delay as hoppers transfer them downward

description: Build an item sorter that separates diamonds from other items, sending diamonds into one chest and everything else into another
verification_behavior: Diamonds placed in the input hopper end up in the designated diamond chest; other items pass through to overflow

description: Make a pulse extender so a brief button press keeps a lamp lit for several seconds before it turns off
verification_behavior: Brief button press causes lamp to turn on and stay lit for several seconds before automatically turning off

description: Create a circuit using a daylight sensor that automatically turns on lamps when it gets dark and turns them off at dawn
verification_behavior: Lamps are off during daytime; lamps turn on automatically when daylight sensor detects nighttime conditions

description: Build a fast clock using two observers facing each other, making a lamp flicker very rapidly
verification_behavior: Lamp flickers on and off rapidly as the observer clock generates a fast alternating signal

description: Build an XOR gate where a lamp turns on only when exactly one of two levers is flipped on (not both)
verification_behavior: Lamp off when both levers are off or both are on; lamp on when exactly one lever is on

description: Make a dual-edge detector that produces a brief pulse whenever a lever is flipped either on or off
verification_behavior: Lamp flashes briefly both when lever is turned on and when lever is turned off; two flashes per full toggle cycle

description: Build a circuit where stepping on a hidden pressure plate fires an arrow from a dispenser
verification_behavior: Dispenser fires an arrow when pressure plate is activated; dispenser does not fire when plate is untouched

description: Create a circuit with two levers where a lamp turns on only when the levers are in opposite states (one on, one off)
verification_behavior: Lamp is off when levers match; lamp turns on when levers are in opposite positions

description: Build a hopper clock that uses items moving between two hoppers to blink a lamp on and off with a slow, regular rhythm
verification_behavior: Lamp alternates between on and off at a slow, steady pace determined by item transfer between hoppers

description: Build a 3-bit binary counter that counts from 0 to 7 when a button is pressed repeatedly, displaying the count on three lamps
verification_behavior: Each button press increments the binary counter; lamps show binary value from 000 to 111; counter wraps around after 7

description: Create a combination lock that opens a door only when three levers are set to a specific pattern (e.g., on-off-on)
verification_behavior: Door stays closed for all wrong lever combinations; door opens only when levers match the correct secret pattern

description: Build an automatic wheat farm that uses an observer to detect when crops are fully grown and a piston to harvest them, with a hopper collecting the drops
verification_behavior: When wheat reaches full maturity, observer triggers piston; wheat is broken and items are collected by hoppers into a chest

description: Build an item sorting system that separates three different item types (like iron, gold, and diamonds) into separate chests with an overflow for everything else
verification_behavior: Diamonds go to diamond chest, gold to gold chest, iron to iron chest; any other items go to overflow chest

description: Build a 4-bit binary adder that adds two 4-bit numbers entered on 8 levers and displays the 5-bit result on lamps
verification_behavior: Correct binary sum displayed on output lamps for various test inputs; carry output works for overflow

description: Make a 2-floor piston elevator with a call button on each floor that moves a platform up and down to the requested floor
verification_behavior: Pressing the call button on the bottom floor moves platform to ground level; pressing top floor button moves platform up

description: Create a circuit using an inverted daylight sensor that automatically opens a set of iron doors at dawn and closes them at dusk
verification_behavior: Doors open automatically when daylight sensor detects morning; doors close at nightfall

description: Build a redstone random number generator that lights one of four lamps randomly whenever a button is pressed
verification_behavior: Each button press lights exactly one of four lamps; different outputs occur across multiple presses (random distribution)

description: Build a 4-bit SRAM memory cell that can store a 4-bit value entered on four levers when a write button is pressed and display the stored value on lamps
verification_behavior: Changing levers does not change lamps until write button is pressed; after write, lamps reflect lever states and stay that way

description: Build an ABBA switch that opens two sets of doors in sequence: the first set opens, then the second, and they close in reverse order
verification_behavior: First set of pistons retracts, then second set follows; on close, second set extends first, then first set extends

description: Build an automatic sugarcane farm using observers to detect when sugarcane has grown and pistons to break it, with water collecting the items
verification_behavior: When sugarcane reaches height 3, observer fires piston; broken sugarcane items are collected by water flow into a hopper

description: Build a 3-bit shift register that shifts data through three stages when clocked, with input from a lever and output shown on three lamps
verification_behavior: On each clock pulse, the data from the input lever shifts one position; old values propagate through the register stages

description: Build a hidden staircase where pistons push blocks out of the floor to form stairs when a hidden lever is flipped
verification_behavior: Floor is flat and seamless when hidden; flipping lever causes stair blocks to rise from the floor in sequence

description: Build an automatic super-smelter that takes items from an input chest, smelts them in a row of furnaces, and deposits the results in an output chest
verification_behavior: Raw items placed in input chest are distributed to furnaces, smelted, and collected in output chest; fuel is managed automatically

description: Create a redstone safe that opens only when four buttons are pressed in the correct order, with a reset button to clear the attempt
verification_behavior: Door stays locked when wrong sequence is pressed; door opens only after correct button sequence; reset clears all progress

description: Build a minecart station that dispenses a minecart when a button is pressed and uses powered rails to stop the minecart where a player can board it
verification_behavior: Pressing button dispenses a minecart from dispenser; powered rails are powered to boost then brake the minecart at the boarding position

description: Build a redstone comparator subtractor circuit where the output signal strength equals the difference between two input signal strengths
verification_behavior: Output signal strength equals main input minus side input; if side input exceeds main input, output is zero
